verdict.rationale: Datadog documents managed evaluations that attach scores to individual spans. These evaluators can be configured, saved as drafts, and enabled later, and examples include language-mismatch and sensitive-information flags. The pack never explicitly says these evaluators use an LLM as judge, and the submit_evaluation API only ingests externally computed scores, so it is a building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the evaluators are LLM-as-a-judge, documentation of custom judge prompts/models/rubrics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators

citations.quote: Agent Observability associates evaluations with individual spans so you can view the inputs and outputs that led to a specific evaluation.
Alternatively, you can Save as Draft and edit or enable it later.
